Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly identified "The Pirates: The Last Royal Treasure" (2022) as "Royal Treasure," which led to confusion and misinterpretation of the task. This initial error propagated through subsequent steps, delaying the resolution of the task and misdirecting efforts toward irrelevant results.
